posts.raw_content:
The was a complete rejection of making campaign promises of going after crony politicians, releasing the Epstein files, no more endless wars, and putting America First - and failing miserably on all of them.


Nothing America first came to fruition in these 2 years. It was the same old GOP that everyone is tired of. They just delay the ever growing wave of communists in our country, but nothing to actually fight back.


By failing on all of these fronts all of the low propsenity voters did not show up AT ALL, and independents revolted.


Had this administration delivered on actual MAGA promises there would be no blue wave, we would be shifting into a new Golden Age that Trump spoke of.


Israel controlling our politicians and media was the biggest threat to our country, and kicking out politicians and spokesperson who called this out was the biggest mistake. 


So where do we go from here? Pray that we can hold off mass amnesty and retake positions of power in 2028 with people who put America First.


America First. America ONLY.


“…It is our true policy to steer clear of permanent alliances with any portion of the foreign world; so far, I mean, as we are now at liberty to do it; for let me not be understood as capable of patronizing infidelity to existing engagements. I hold the maxim no less applicable to public than to private affairs, that honesty is always the best policy. I repeat it, therefore, let those engagements be observed in their genuine sense. But, in my opinion, it is unnecessary and would be unwise to extend them. Taking care always to keep ourselves by suitable establishments on a respectable defensive posture, we may safely trust to temporary alliances for extraordinary emergencies.

Harmony, liberal intercourse with all nations, are recommended by policy, humanity, and interest. But even our commercial policy should hold an equal and impartial hand; neither seeking nor granting exclusive favors or preferences; consulting the natural course of things; diffusing and diversifying by gentle means the streams of commerce, but forcing nothing; establishing (with powers so disposed, in order to give trade a stable course, to define the rights of our merchants, and to enable the government to support them) conventional rules of intercourse, the best that present circumstances and mutual opinion will permit, but temporary, and liable to be from time to time abandoned or varied, as experience and circumstances shall dictate; constantly keeping in view that it is folly in one nation to look for disinterested favors from another; that it must pay with a portion of its independence for whatever it may accept under that character; that, by such acceptance, it may place itself in the condition of having given equivalents for nominal favors, and yet of being reproached with ingratitude for not giving more. There can be no greater error than to expect or calculate upon real favors from nation to nation. It is an illusion, which experience must cure, which a just pride ought to discard.”

— George Washington, Farewell Address, 1796

posts.raw_content:
Practice your aim sparingly, and conserve your cartridge supply. 

Collect basic medications for you and your loved ones, and medical tools. Syringes, scalpels, hemostats.

Get a collection of textbooks sufficient for a homeschooling ciriculuum, before those textbooks are retroactively edited. English, Math, Social Studies, Science, Health, Physical Education, Craft, and Foreign Language (probably should be Spanish, like it or not it'll be the most useful). Get/print out physical copies, do not trust ones hosted online because they can still be edited. 

Pray more, and practice being stoic. Rule yourself and cultivate the self-discipline you know you lack.

Learn how to survive for at least 3 months without access to electricity, clean running water, or grocery access. Have the tools and supplies needed to last that long if possible; pool resources if needed. Look to the Pentagon's current Operation Fortress preparations and follow their lead. They're preparing to save themselves and are leaving the civilian infrastructure completely unhardened. Take their preparation as a warning.

Tell no one you are preparing for anything. If they know you have stockpiled, and something terrible happens, they will eventually come begging for food because they didn't prepare and they'll eventually turn hostile if you refuse.

In the meantime, be active in your communities and try to work on civil solutions, for as long as the solutions remain available. This is my rule of thumb: *"Until the last ember dies in the last burned remnants of the last surviving courthouse in the entire country, and there is thereafter truly and totally no remaining venue to be heard civilly under the law, you shall not pick up your rifle for any other purpose but hunting and self-defense. Non-negotiable. Last resort means the last resort."*

And I'll say this twice: Pray. More.
